title: Multi-Agents LLM Financial Trading Framework
summary: A multi-agent framework using Large Language Models to make collaborative financial trading decisions, where different AI agents specialize in various tasks like market analysis, sentiment analysis, and risk assessment before reaching trading conclusions.
problem_solved: Enables automated, multi-perspective financial trading decisions by coordinating multiple specialized AI agents instead of relying on single-point decision making.
why_valuable: Leverages collaborative AI agent architecture to reduce bias and improve decision quality in financial trading by dividing cognitive load across specialized roles.
